answer: Proposal: influence equals locked capital, nothing else. Each identity stakes a bond in a protocol vault; the fixed epoch reward pool is paid pro-rata by bonded weight — an orchard whose yield per bonded unit is fixed, so fencing one plot into k keys adds no fruit. Every bonded key must whisper a signed heartbeat each slot; a miss is slashed, and registration burns a fee. Splitting stake into k identities keeps total reward unchanged and adds k burned fees plus k heartbeat duties, so sybils strictly lose. Leaks: capital concentration is unsolved; slashing assumes an honest quorum.
